claim: Most of Blood's ceiling-lifting doors are CLOSED at rest: of the campaign's 622 type 600 sectors that lift the ceiling over a fixed floor, 509 are shut in their OFF pose (ceiling down on the floor) and open by raising the ceiling to the lintel; 85 are shut in their ON pose, and 2 of those start ON, so 511 are shut at rest and 83 open; 28 never close fully. E3M1's simple ones are 256 to 1,024 across and 57 to 256 thick (s52 768 by 256, s114 and s354 1,024 by 128).
evidence: E3M1 s52: type 600, off_ceiling_z = off_floor_z = -7168 (the pose trInit gives it at load; a stored ceiling_z may differ, as s354's does), on_ceiling_z -25600 (python -m tools.catalog record E3M1 sector 52); likewise E3M1 s58, s114 and s354. (s59 and s60 open by dropping the floor, and s54's floor also moves 1,024: they are not ceiling-lifting doors.)

knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_zdoors_rest.py over the 43 campaign maps, 2026-11-26: 622 type 600 with ceiling moving and floor fixed, 509 with off_floor_z = off_ceiling_z, 85 with on_floor_z = on_ceiling_z; trInit (NBlood/source/blood/src/triggers.cpp:2248-2250) sets each to its state's pose at load

E3M1's ceiling-lifting doors shut at rest with four walls (s52, s58, s105, s114, s181, s354) measure 256-1,024 across and 57-256 thick (knowledge/blood/findings/probes/consolidation_audit3_p6.py, 2026-11-26)
use: Build a Z door as a thin leaf sector shut at rest; choose its tile by its owner-anchored role (and see knob-doors-never-open-by-z-motion).
